notes.title: Released ver.1.2.1
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where walking behavior became unstable when frame rate increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted, replaced, and added sound effects such as button input sounds and footsteps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where diamond, star, and medal-shaped objects did not trigger the door-opening mechanism even when aligned at the correct angle.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed BGM compression method to shorten loading times.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the handling of the final boss’s “Careless State”.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Korean and Traditional Chinese support.[/p][/*][*][p]Added resolution settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252257/073c66b6593b467e6ad884c12de8cb90352ae702.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where walking behavior became unstable when frame rate increased.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted, replaced, and added sound effects such as button input sounds and footsteps.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where diamond, star, and medal-shaped objects did not trigger the door-opening mechanism even when aligned at the correct angle.

tags.feature: Changed BGM compression method to shorten loading times.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the handling of the final boss’s “Careless State”.

tags.feature: Added Korean and Traditional Chinese support.
Added resolution settings.

notes.title: Released ver.1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252257/adbc59605042250c5aec5bf0d7aab8ec8a0dd4e5.png[/img]
- Redesigned option screen.
-Changed the gamepad button assignments a little.
-Compatible with the vibration function on the PC version 
 (it will not vibrate unless it is a compatible gamepad)
-Replaced the image displayed in the ending.
-Added sound effects, adjusted volume, and replaced.
-Adjusted the BGM of the last battle.
-Made it easier to start the event in the direction the player is facing.
-Fixed an issue where fried eggs could not be done without Grill.
-Adjusted the position of objects to make hints easier to understand.
-Increased hint lines.
- Added Spanish language.

tags.feature: - Redesigned option screen.

 (it will not vibrate unless it is a compatible gamepad)
-Replaced the image displayed in the ending.
-Added sound effects, adjusted volume, and replaced.
-Made it easier to start the event in the direction the player is facing.
